semantics.heater: On exactly when mode=1 and too_cold=1
semantics.aircon: On exactly when mode=0 and too_hot=1
semantics.fan: On exactly when heater, aircon, or fan_on is on
semantics.timing: Outputs follow current inputs after combinational settling; no clock or cycle latency
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior
semantics.simultaneous_temperature_flags: Mode selects the applicable flag even when both flags are asserted

numeric.type: One-bit unsigned Boolean inputs and outputs
numeric.arithmetic: Boolean operations only; no arithmetic, overflow, rounding, saturation, or truncation
numeric.unknown_inputs: X/Z behavior is unspecified by the original problem; verification covers binary inputs

verification.plan: Exhaustively drive all 16 binary input combinations and compare outputs to an independent mode-based procedural oracle
checks: Fan active with either appliance or manual request
Every output defined for all binary input combinations
verification.tools: Icarus Verilog v12 with -g2012, explicit dev_tb top, and finite compile/run timeouts
